hero_kpi_rationale: SL Green is a REIT that owns and manages commercial office properties in Manhattan. As of December 31, 2025, the consolidated portfolio covers approximately 9.5 million rentable square feet and the unconsolidated portfolio approximately 13.9 million rentable square feet. This metric measures the size and revenue-generating capacity of the real estate portfolio, a fundamental element of the shareholder value creation strategy.

kpis.name: Total Rentable Square Feet
kpis.explanation: Total rentable area owned or in which interests are held in commercial operating properties.
kpis.description: Represents the total rentable square feet (RSF) that SL Green owns or holds interests in, including consolidated and unconsolidated properties.
kpis.signal: Measures the size and revenue-generating capacity of the real estate portfolio.

kpis.name: Consolidated Properties
kpis.explanation: Number of commercial office buildings consolidated on SL Green's balance sheet.
kpis.description: Counts the total number of commercial office buildings that SL Green consolidates in its financial statements, located primarily in Midtown Manhattan.
kpis.signal: Indicator of real estate portfolio diversification and scale.

kpis.name: Unconsolidated Properties
kpis.explanation: Number of commercial office buildings held in partnership without consolidation.
kpis.description: Counts the total number of commercial office buildings that SL Green holds an interest in without consolidation, representing approximately 13.9 million RSF.
kpis.signal: Measures exposure to co-investments and strategic partnerships.

kpis.name: Cybersecurity Management Experience
kpis.explanation: Combined years of executive-level cybersecurity management experience.
kpis.description: The Senior Director, Information Security Network Systems and Senior Vice President, Information Technology bring over 30 years of combined experience in managing cybersecurity risks and overseeing information security initiatives.
kpis.signal: Indicates depth of expertise in information risk management.

ai_positioning.summary: SL Green Realty Corp. is a REIT focused on office real estate in Manhattan. While the text mentions cybersecurity and information risk management, there is no indication of a specific strategy or positioning related to artificial intelligence.
evidence: The text mentions board and committee oversight of risks, including cybersecurity.
The Senior Director, Information Security Network Systems and the Senior Vice President, Information Technology are responsible for assessing and managing cybersecurity risks.
